text:
liz-b: Heads up — joint marketplace announcement with CloudOne next week. Need to lock SKU->Redwood plan mapping and confirm metering payloads. Who owns mapping for per-second vs per-token usage? Also, what about free trial credits entitlements and how they reflect in partner billing?

raj: I can own SKU mapping. quick q: CloudOne sends usage in milli-seconds for compute, while we consume 'token' counts. Do we have a canonical conversion?

mica: We need a conversion matrix. For HW partners it's different. Suggest we add a 'usage_dimension' field in the payload and map on ingestion so downstream billing can choose conversion per-sku.

partners-bot: @here CloudOne integration: org onboarding doc updated https://confluence.internal/cloudone-marketplace (added sample payload + signing keys) :eyes:

jess: For reconciliation: we should emit both 'reported_usage' and 'billable_usage' in our daily export so partners can reconcile. Example payload we expect:

```
{
  "usage_window_start":"2026-03-20T00:00:00Z",
  "usage_window_end":"2026-03-20T01:00:00Z",
  "sku_id":"cloudone-ai-llm",
  "reported_units":12345,
  "unit_type":"tokens",
  "billable_units":12345,
  "entitlement_id":"ent-abc-123"
}
```

raj: Nice. What about backfill semantics when partner replays late usage? Do we allow negative adjustments?

sam-sysops: We support adjustments via POST /marketplace/usage/adjust with reason codes. Policy: allow up to 30 days backfill, adjustments create delta events and we run a daily reconcile job to apply credits/debits.

accounting: FYI — negative adjustments need manual approval above $10k. +1 on audit trail fields: created_by, partner_txn_id, approval_id.

paul-integrations: For marketplace webhooks, recommend idempotency key `partner_txn_id` and signature header `X-Partner-Signature`. Sample curl to test:

```
curl -H "X-Partner-Signature: abc123" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '@sample.json' https://api.redwood.com/marketplace/webhook
```

liz-b: Great. Next steps: raj to draft SKU map, jess to update reconciliation export schema, paul to add webhook idempotency patch, sam to add docs for backfill TTL, accounting to confirm approval threshold. Can we aim for EOD tomorrow?

jess: Working on the schema now, will push PR to infra repo. :rocket:

raj: I'll drop initial SKU map in this thread by noon. :+1:

liz-b: thanks everyone. tagging @legal for any contract language re credits — @maria-legal can you weigh in?

maria-legal: we'll need to add a clause for usage corrections and crediting timelines, will send suggested wording.

partners-bot: Deploy log: marketplace-ingest v2.14 deployed 1749123500

liz-b: awesome, closing loop. :white_check_mark:
